parole.significato: a prefix signifying crummy old..., devil of a..., big old...
parole.testo: Probably from Proto-Indo-European *peh₂w-. Latin paucus (“few, little”), pauper (“poor”), paulus (“small”), parvus (“small”), Old Armenian փոքր (pʻokʻr) and Old English fēaw (English few).
